correctness.rationale: For all nonnegative dimensions, the difference map has rational rank s, whose s independent degree-one pullbacks have nonzero exterior product, forcing relaxed TC at least s. Category of the connected image subtorus gives s+1 explicit local target planners. Equality of image cosets is forced by both synchronized endpoint images; if equal, smooth surjective torus homomorphisms corestrict to bundles permitting continuous lifts of the target planners, giving strict TC s. Smith normal form of [-A B] identifies nonempty coincidence fibres as translated kernels with exactly product d_i components, each T^(a+b-s). The character annihilator and rational span certify the exact finite test. Edge dimensions s=0 and exact offset cases included; no finite enumeration used as proof.

value.rationale: The recent invariants make exact synchronization of two torus-valued sensors/agents a natural new complete-classification problem. The theorem resolves every dimension, integer map and phase translation, distinguishing overlapping but unequal image subtori from compatible covers. Its component torsion factor shows an independent obstruction profile: circle covers of degrees 2 and 3 versus 2 and 4 have identical TC values but different compatibility fibre topology. The full decision is computable by rational rank, integral kernels and Smith normal form; no physical-performance claims are made.
